INTEL
=====
📌The group initially appeared (DLS) in August 2026 listing 2 victims (as of now)
📌Falcon does not use Vanity Domain
💡Falcon's domain registered on 10th July 2026: passkeyhelpdesk[.]com
💡Both victim leaks are updated on July 24, 2026 and August 22, 2026
💡Hence, the attack could be early July which coincides with their Domain Registration Date
📌Observed leak size are huge when compared to other group victims
💡Falcon's DLS is hosted with nginx Server on a VPS facility
📌Falcon only admits their association with Redact Ransomware Group which had listed on 2 victims in June 2026
💡Falcon tries to discredit the Researchers by releasing a notice about their non-association of UNC6671, which is a tactical move to derail the investigation
💡We have spotted this tactic is being used by Gentlemen Ransomware Group who comments on VT
🤡Redact Ransomware Group also made the same post on their DLS targeting Google Threat Intelligence regarding discrediting the research and came up with "clearing up misconception" which should be treated with a grain of salt, after all they are criminals, they can claim/deny anything!
🤡The group also tampers the image of other Ransomware Players like 'Pink' or 'Helix' and advising "NOT TO PAY" which is hilarious as they too are in the same line of business!
